# רוני אליאב (Roni Eliav)

> מרפאה בעיסוק ומטפלת מוסמכת בשיטת Cog-Fun. Occupational therapist and certified Cog-Fun therapist, offering parent counselling, emotional regulation, ADHD therapy for children, online support for adults with ADHD, and training courses for occupational therapists. Site language: Hebrew.
